'''Colu's syndrome''' was a rare, yet extremely deadly cancer that strangely only affected the descendants of the survivors of the [[Destruction of Taris]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the medical doctor [[Synoda]] asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] allied individual to enter [[Dynamet General Hospital]] in order to download patient records. The individual managed to do so, and was able to deliver the data and research to Synoda in order to find a possible cure.
